summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md plus the four UI guideline docs. The conversation auto-compacted twice before the first question. Without any visual cue from me, the agent then said the task was bounded, ran the companion's start-server.sh, and gave me a localhost URL with a key. It wrote a placement.html screen showing three layouts (A filter bar, B Filter button with a panel, C compact row) and asked me to reply in the terminal. I picked A. It then asked its other questions (tokens, no-JS rows) in the terminal, posted a short design in chat, and asked for approval. When I said "Yes, go ahead" it started implementation work. It created no spec file and no plan document.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was met, and the session log and files on disk back this up. The companion was opened at the first visual question, the bounded classification held, and no spec or plan was written. The agent asked for approval before writing any code. It only had read-only implementation steps in flight when I stopped watching, and the second auto-compaction was in progress at that point.

observations.description: Claude Code's startup trust dialog and bypass-permissions warning both default to "No, exit". I had to press Down before Enter each time.
A 'Newer Opus model available' prompt appeared at launch saying 'Currently pinned: Opus 5', even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. That looks inconsistent. I chose No.

The agent recommended option C, which drops the date range and search, even though the brainstorm included the 'one particular week' need from the story's honest answers. That's reasonable, but it pushed toward the smallest option over full coverage.
The agent told the user to add .hyperpowers/ to .gitignore instead of handling it itself. The companion leaves untracked files (git status: ?? .hyperpowers/).

The agent asked two extra AskUserQuestion prompts after the layout pick (token sheet, no-JS rendering) and then asked for approval a second time. That's several confirmation rounds for a bounded task.

The conversation auto-compacted twice before the first question and a third time right after implementation started ('0% until auto-compact'). That came from reading the long guideline docs. The companion behavior survived the compactions.

criteria.evidence: The first tool_use in the session JSONL is {"name":"Skill","i":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:brainstorming\"}"}. A grep for skill names returned only "hyperpowers:brainstorming" (1 hit).

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened with a localhost URL and an HTML screen of candidate layouts
criteria.evidence: Bash tool_use: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir \"$PWD\" --open". Screen: "I've opened a browser tab with three wireframes: http://localhost:56062/?key=22f65ff1...". The file .hyperpowers/brainstorm/*/content/placement.html has three <h3> headings: "Filter bar between the intro and the table", "One \"Filter\" button that opens a panel", "Compact row: failed sign-ins toggle plus event type...".

criteria.criterion: Companion opened just-in-time, and non-visual questions were not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Tool order in the log: Skill → reading NOTES/repo/the 4 guideline docs → reading visual-companion.md → start-server.sh → writing placement.html. The screen said "the first question is where the controls go, which is easier to judge by looking". The later non-visual questions (tokens, no-JS rows) used AskUserQuestion in the terminal. The content dir holds only placement.html and waiting.html.

Screen: "This is a bounded change... so I'll give you a short design here in chat once a few questions are settled, not a spec document." The final design was posted in chat (Files list, ~220 lines estimate, "Do you want me to go ahead with this?").
`ls docs/superpowers docs/hyperpowers` returned "No such file or directory" for both. `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. `git status --short` shows only "?? .hyperpowers/".

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The skill grep shows only hyperpowers:brainstorming. A find for *plan* / *spec* files in the workdir returned nothing.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of the layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "My recommendation is C... You can click an option in the browser, but please reply here as well." No public/ files had been modified before my pick: git status showed only .hyperpowers/. It asked "Do you want me to go ahead with this?" again before coding.

After the pick, the screen showed "Option A it is—I'll proceed with the filter bar above the table." After "Yes, go ahead." it started implementation steps: "Reading form layout rules and filter-related lines" (sed/grep on 03-forms.md), followed by an auto-compaction.
